fieldissues.issue: The title says DOGE completed mass firings and reduced USAID to exactly 291 staff, while the medium and long describe a reported plan to cut staffing below 300. The short repeats the title.
The long refers to “the supplied account” and repeatedly says later figures “would need to be established separately,” which reads as internal review commentary.

proposedchanges.change: Use “Reports Describe Plan to Cut USAID Workforce Below 300.” Write a distinct short that separates the reported staffing plan from completed dismissals and says which officials were placed on leave, if that remains in the account.

Remove source-review references and state directly that reports described planned reductions and that later staffing totals and office closures are not specified in the retained account. Do not present 291 as a completed headcount.

evidencebasis: The assigned packet and merged medium and long describe a plan to reduce the workforce to fewer than 300, not a verified final count of 291.
The merged long distinguishes announced reductions, administrative leave, and completed dismissals.
The Hill source URL supplied in the packet remains in source_urls.
notes: The long preserves the important distinction between a plan and completed job losses. The title contradicts that distinction and adds internal source-review language.

The long adds an April 2025 LIV tournament and Trump Organization revenue at Doral, but the only retained URL is a February 20 New York Times report about Trump’s meeting with Saudi PIF and Tiger Woods.

proposedchanges.change: Use a title such as “Trump Discusses Possible PGA–LIV Deal While LIV Holds Tournament at Doral.” Write a distinct short that says the merger remained unresolved and describes any payment as revenue to the Trump Organization, not personal receipts to Trump.

Add a source for the April Doral tournament and reported course revenue if those details remain. Otherwise narrow the entry to the February merger discussions covered by the retained New York Times report.

evidencebasis: The packet and merged medium say the possible talks had not produced a merger and do not quantify Doral’s revenue.

notes: The title overstates both the deal’s status and who received the tournament revenue. The April business event also needs source coverage beyond the retained February report.
